trust_decision.summary: Which auth-provider group list becomes the user's stored memberships (and so their group-derived roles/access): at the pinned commit ensureGroups fetches over HTTP and persistGroups unconditionally reconciles group_memberships to that fetch, so a slower, stale fetch can commit after a newer one and re-insert a revoked membership; the fix makes the write a compare-and-swap on identities.auth_provider_groups_last_checked and stops other identity writes from rewriting that column.

landing_point.why: ensureGroups is the only function that fetches provider groups and calls persistGroups; 'group membership refresh race' leads straight to it.

fix_sites.entry_point: every authenticated HTTP request via UserDecorator.AuthenticateRequest -> EnsureIdentity -> ensureIdentityProviderData -> ensureGroups (pkg/gateway/client/auth.go:67, pkg/gateway/client/identity.go:100)
fix_sites.module_kind: core group-refresh logic (throttle check, now singleflight + cooldown + DB re-read)

fix_sites.entry_point: same auth path; persistGroups gains the CAS claim on auth_provider_groups_last_checked (fix.diff:1086-1104)
same auth path; follow-up full-struct identity write of the new check time removed (fix.diff:1613-1631)
encryptAndUpdateIdentity, reached from ensureIdentity (identity.go:361) and lookup-ID persistence (identity.go:434-436) on the auth path

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: pkg/gateway/client/user.go:329-335 + pkg/gateway/client/user.go:430-435 (identity row loaded, provider profile fetched over HTTP at user.go:346, then the whole stale struct is written back with gorm Updates, rewriting auth_provider_groups_last_checked); same shape at pkg/gateway/client/identity.go:146 and pkg/gateway/client/identity.go:497

O3_reason_to_dismiss: UpdateProfileIfNeeded is an icon/display-name refresh on GET /api/me and EncryptIdentities is an admin re-encryption job; neither touches groups or group_memberships, so a solver can argue they are unrelated to a membership race, even though rewriting the timestamp column defeats any CAS keyed on it.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The HTTP fetch must stay outside any DB transaction (holding a pooled connection across it deadlocks in-process providers on the single SQLite connection), so the obvious 'lock the identity row across fetch+persist' fix is ruled out; first-ever refresh with a zero/NULL check time must still claim; profile icon, group lookup ID and user_id updates on the identity row must still persist; DeleteAuthProviderGroupData must still reset the check time.

O6_input_shapes: stored check time non-zero and unchanged since read (claim succeeds)
stored check time zero or NULL on a first refresh (claim uses '= ? OR IS NULL', fix.diff:1089-1092)
stored check time advanced by another flight/replica during the fetch (claim fails, fetched groups discarded, cached groups returned, fix.diff:1035-1039)
in-memory identity copy stale vs DB (re-read before fetch, fix.diff:1011-1017)
concurrent same-process callers (singleflight) and failed fetches (cooldown) - rate-limit side of the same commit

O7_producer.where: gorm struct Updates of types.Identity, which writes every non-zero field including AuthProviderGroupsLastChecked (pkg/gateway/types/identity.go:23): pkg/gateway/client/identity.go:497, pkg/gateway/client/identity.go:146, pkg/gateway/client/user.go:434

O8_uncovered_routes.route: DeleteAuthProviderGroupData resets every identity's check time to zero; an in-flight refresh that itself read a zero check time can still pass the zero/NULL claim afterwards and re-create groups and memberships for the removed provider (ABA on zero)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: provider deconfiguration cleanup is a separate controller feature, and the provider is probably unreachable by then
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the landing point

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second identity write-back path (e.g. persisting a refreshed ProviderGroupLookupID or email correction) using a full-struct tx.Save/Updates that rewrites auth_provider_groups_last_checked
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the lookup-ID refresh already persists the whole struct after an HTTP call; a maintainer adding another provider-profile field would copy that pattern

O8b_injection_room.sibling: token/JWT auth path that triggers its own group refresh (fetch + reconcile) instead of only reading ListGroupIDsForUser
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: recent commit f385f2f3 added group population for token auth; a refresh-on-token variant in another package would be a real second implementation at distance

O8b_injection_room.sibling: API-key auth path that refreshes groups from the provider with a separate persist helper lacking the claim
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: API keys need fresh group-based access too; a maintainer could add a refresh here in a different package

O9_family: race condition / TOCTOU: stale concurrent write (lost update) restoring revoked authorization state

O10_build.project_tests: pkg/gateway/client/group_test.go (testGroupContext, seedGroups) and in-memory SQLite client from pkg/gateway/client/auditlogcleanup_test.go:15-19; fix adds pkg/gateway/client/group_refresh_test.go using httptest provider stubs

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Wrap ensureGroups in a per-identity mutex or singleflight: it only serialises one process, so another replica or a stale full-struct identity write (profile refresh, re-encryption) still lets an old fetch overwrite newer memberships.
